show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/AaHsHa
show.description: When sweet, faceless housewife Alisha—secretly the Raichand empire’s “princess”—is framed in a scandal and thrown out by her greedy husband Vicky, she stops begging and starts hunting. With the help of his disgraced step-uncle Rishi and her ruthless brother Harsh, Alisha storms high society to expose the Oberois, bankrupt their lies, and turn her divorce into a public coronation… and a dangerous new love.
